title: SAGE: A Framework of Precise Retrieval for RAG
authors: Jintao Zhang; Guoliang Li; Jinyang Su
why_relevant: SAGE addresses noisy and missing retrieval in RAG via semantic chunking, dynamic gradient-based chunk selection, and LLM self-feedback to adjust K, directly targeting noisy-context robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on retrieval precision/cost rather than adversarial robustness or calibration of abstention; relevance limited to noisy-retrieval subsection.
